hook: Former congressman David Rivera got 10 years in federal prison for a secret foreign lobbying scheme.

sections.voiceover: Former congressman David Rivera got 10 years in federal prison for a secret foreign lobbying scheme.
Federal prosecutors charged the 61-year-old Republican who represented Florida from 2011 to 2013 with money laundering. Which foreign regime paid him 50 million dollars?
Venezuelan state-run oil money flowed into his firm, but the federal 7-week trial exposed it.
Nicolás Maduro's regime secured his consulting services to lobby Washington in secret. The massive lobbying operation collapsed in federal court.
David Rivera sits in federal prison for the 50 million dollar deal.
